basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old DJ based in Brooklyn, NY, with a passion for music and community. When I'm not spinning tracks at local clubs or online parties, you can find me discussing vinyl collections on Reddit or sharing tips on sound mixing. I enjoy exploring the evolving world of digital music production, but I'm also a huge fan of classic punk rock, which led me to discover crustpunk communities. Although I'm usually online during the late hours due to my night owl tendencies, I make it a point to engage with my followers and fellow Redditors. Currently, I'm single and focusing on my career in music. I also have a side interest in virtual pet games like Marapets, which I find relaxing.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Audio Engineering from a local community college and have been DJing professionally for over five years. My interest in music is both a hobby and a career, and I've taught myself various DJing techniques and music production software.
